Container.Name: NextDash
Container.DonateText: Find NextDash useful? Consider supporting the project.
Container.Overview:
NextDash is a lightweight, self-hosted bookmark dashboard that features a minimalist, keyboard-driven interface with extensive customization options, making it the perfect personal dashboard for power users. Based on the excellent ThinkDashboard.
Key features: • Keyboard-driven navigation for fast access to all your bookmarks • Extensive theme and layout customization • Inbox feature to quickly collect new links and organize them later • Lightweight and fast, no heavy dependencies • Actively maintained with regular releases
Links: • Website: https://www.nextdash.cc • Source code and releases: https://github.com/jordibrouwer/nextdash • Changelog: https://github.com/jordibrouwer/nextdash/releases • Devlog / release updates: https://www.nextdash.cc/news • Also available on GHCR: ghcr.io/jordibrouwer/nextdash:latest
Support: open an issue on GitHub via the Support link above. Bug reports and feature requests are welcome.
